sourceTransformBasis: Original source world loops: first10 Western hills, last12 Northern source cones; exact validation guard retained.
method: Construct actual old and candidate source meshes. Count actual west vertices/triangle centroids inside real camera frusta. Clip each source west triangle against all six homogeneous clip planes, convert surviving polygons to1280x800 screen space, evaluate projected top envelope at every x-column center. Compare old/new actual upper silhouette values at overlapping columns; list coverage changes and16 nonoverlapping80px bins. No raster image generation, lighting, camera changes or product source mutation.
limitations: Projected source coverage proves geometry is in the actual camera and its screen-space silhouette changes. It does not prove actual rendered visibility after terrain/buildings/NPC occlusion, shader/material art quality or AAA completion.
All scene occluders are intentionally absent from this CPU geometry comparison. Native original PNGs remain required.
Pixel deltas are actual computed values, not an invented success threshold.1px and5px counts are descriptive statistics, not acceptance gates.
This analysis is bound to the source SHA snapshots shown. If candidate edits after it, run a separately declared new proof rather than treating the existing proof as valid for changed bytes.
